title: Panni Kutty
desc: As bad luck follows Utharavathi, he is advised to run over Varahi, a piglet, in a bid to bring good fortune. On the other hand, a desperate Thittani must keep the little Varahi safe to get married.

title: Aayirathil Oruvan
desc: When a reputed archaeologist, Chandramouli, disappears from his research expedition, his daughter, Lavanya, teams up with a government official, Anitha, to find him.

title: Saamy
desc: Aarusaamy, a police officer, accepts bribes from Perumal, a gangster, in order to maintain peace in his district. However, circumstances force him to go against Perumal.

title: Raaja
desc: Raaja, who makes his living by doing menial jobs, falls in love with Sudha. Sudha witnesses a murder in her hospital and vows to put the culprit behind bars with Raaja's help.

title: Inimey Ippadithan
desc: Seenu starts hunting for a girl after his astrologer advises him to get married within three months. He falls in love with Maha and wins her heart, but his parents get him engaged to Akhila.

title: Aanazhagan
desc: Raja disguises himself as a married woman to find a rental house for his friends. However, trouble brews when he falls for the landlady's daughter.

title: Jayam
desc: The police of Tamil Nadu hunt down Saamy, an eccentric scientist who actively participated in terrorist attacks. Later, when he is released from prison, one of his experiments causes chaos.

title: Jenma Natchathiram
desc: After a man loses his child, he adopts a baby. However, a few years later, he discovers that the baby is the devil incarnate.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.
Three men with distinct special needs unexpectedly fall for the same woman, sparking a unique and complicated love story filled with challenges and emotions.
